answer: The nectar I would price into every new account is Trademark filing with the office: a mark filed and examined by the office, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a mark filed and examined by the office takes calendar time as well as money — and the quartz is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The falcon is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
